description: Opener: what an OCT B-scan is, a quiet slice beside one with obvious cystoid edema, fluid pockets marked.
The pipeline in five pictures and no equations: raw scan, denoised, retina located, dark pockets picked out, final result against the specialist.
MAIN RESULT SLIDE. Our automatic contour (red) against the specialist tracing (green) for six different patients, each one that patient''s largest lesion, with the overlap printed as a percentage.

Accuracy against the only meaningful yardstick: how well the two expert graders agree with EACH OTHER on the very same scans. Both bars computed on the same subsets, so the comparison is like-for-like.
The clinical layer: one annotated scan showing fluid area, cyst count, diameter and severity, plus the grade distribution across the dataset.
Processing time per scan against the three methods timed in Liu et al. (2021).
Why the operator sweeps in four directions: it finds the most fluid AND runs fastest.
A still of the live MATLAB GUI, as a fallback if the demo cannot be run.
